title: Cycle-aware RICE with Token-Cost Sensitivity and Latency Penalty Index
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Current RICE scoring at Redwood treats Reach, Impact, Confidence, and Effort as static across cycles and does not account for per-token cost sensitivity or latency-exposure of features. That leads to misleading prioritization for inference-heavy initiatives and for workload patterns where latency SLOs are critical. Goal: Deliver a reproducible, cycle-aware prioritization index that augments RICE with (1) a token-cost sensitivity multiplier, (2) a latency-penalty factor tied to SLA band exposure, and (3) a decay term so long-running initiatives progressively require re-evaluation each cycle. Outcome: a single numeric "Priority Index" used by PMs and GTM to rank roadmap items alongside capacity planning and OKR alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Definition doc published in Confluence with clear formula, assumptions, and worked examples
Prototype spreadsheet with sample initiatives and simulated scoring for three historical cycles
Backtest: when applied to last 6 months of closed initiatives, top-decile picks align with business outcomes (>= 70% uplift vs random baseline) per retrospective metric
Dashboard tile in Console showing Priority Index, contributing sub-scores, and sensitivity sliders for token-cost and latency penalty
PM handbook updated with guidance on how to use the index during quarterly planning and OKR setting
metrics: Correlation of Priority Index with realized value (revenue/engagement) -- target rho >= 0.4
Change in average per-token cost for prioritized initiatives post-decision -- target <= 5% regression
Number of roadmap disputes resolved using the index -- qualitative target >= 10 in first two cycles
Adoption: % of PMs using the index in planning templates -- target 80% by two cycles
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: Draft formula and assumptions; workshop with Eng Reliability and Applied ML to validate latency penalty calibration
Week 3: Build prototype spreadsheet and run Monte Carlo sensitivity on token-cost multiplier and decay half-life
Week 4: Publish Confluence doc and hold a cross-functional review with Design, Eng, Sales, and Customer Success
Week 5: Implement simple Priority Index widget in Console's roadmap view (read-only) for pilot group
Week 6-8: Pilot with 6 PMs across infra and platform; capture feedback and adjust weights
Week 9: Roll full adoption, update planning templates and OKR kickoff materials
implementation_notes: Core formula: PriorityIndex = RICE_score * TokenCostMultiplier * LatencyPenalty * CycleDecay
Where RICE_score = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort using canonical RICE scales
TokenCostMultiplier = 1 / (1 + k * normalized_per_token_cost), k tuned by Finance (initial k=2)
LatencyPenalty = 1 - latency_exposure_weight * SLA_band_score (SLA_band_score in [0,1]; higher means more exposed)
CycleDecay = exp(-ln(2) * cycles_since_last_review / half_life_cycles) with default half_life_cycles = 3
Example: Initiative A RICE=50, per_token_cost normalized=0.4 => TokenCostMultiplier~0.55, SLA_band_score=0.7 => LatencyPenalty~0.65 => CycleDecay=0.87 => PriorityIndex~15.6
We will surface the component contributions (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort, TokenCost, Latency, Decay) so reviewers can debate inputs rather than output alone
